scope: Tracked JS/CJS/MJS/JSX at revision; vendor/node_modules excluded. Token-backed nonblank/non-comment occupied physical LOC, including multiline strings. Runtime is path/name classification, not full package reachability. Static controller digests excluded from executable limits; video catalog kept separate because it also mutates catalog records. Fixtures include runtime defaults and remain runtime. No cyclomatic-complexity or semantic certification.
